answer: Trust is earned by surviving a horizon. Each identity keeps a twelve-epoch signal log: five attestations from five distinct established peers, each signing a cipher challenge tied to live work. Each peer attests at most two per epoch, so ten fakes need fifty attestations from twenty-five peers in twelve epochs. Entry locks 60 POA, +25 per extra identity from one root: ten fakes lock 1,725 POA. A fake short of five at close burns 20. The chain reads the attestation graph: attestations sharing the claimant's root are void; five from one root count as one. Time and strangers' eyes are priceless.
